bias.zh: 偏空 · 反弹触及 5 日均线

read.en: Corning rose 3.3% on Oct 26 to $127.74, trading between $122.77 and $128.56 on 1.6 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($128.5), 10-day ($133.5), 30-day ($148.1) and 100-day ($163.5) averages and the rising 200-day ($154.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($141.13), and RSI is 37.
read.zh: 康宁 10月26日上涨 3.3%，收于 $127.74，盘中区间 $122.77–128.56，成交量为平均水平的 1.6 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$128.5）、10 日（$133.5）、30 日（$148.1）和 100 日均线（$163.5）以及上行的 200 日均线（$154.9）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$141.13），RSI 为 37。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $126.7–127.6 resistance (Mar 30 and Oct 20 lows), now support; the $128.56 high stopped at the 5-day. Resistance is $128.5–128.6, then $131.6–133.5 (Oct 16 and 15 lows, 10-day) and $137.4–137.7 (Oct 16 and 19 highs). Support is $126.7–127.6, then $121.8–122.8 and $120 (Mar 9 low). A close above $128.6 would target $131.6–133.5; a close below $126.7 would reopen $122.
